result.description: SBDC testing pty Ltd   Employment Type:  Full-time (38 hours per week) role as a Contract Administrator  SBDC Testing is seeking an experienced Contract Administrator to support the commercial and administrative functions of our growing concrete testing operations. This role is responsible for managing contracts and variations, liaising with project stakeholders, overseeing contractor work, and ensuring compliance across our testing engagements with builders, suppliers and engineers.  As our project workload and client base continue to grow, we are seeking a dedicated Contract Administrator to manage the contractual and administrative side of our testing services. This is a full-time, office-based role supporting our operations across New South Wales, working closely with our technical and operations teams to ensure every engagement is properly documented, compliant, and delivered to the standard our clients expect.      Benefits   Competitive salary commensurate with experience  Ongoing professional development and training opportunities  Supportive and collaborative team environment  Career progression opportunities within a growing business  Standard full-time hours with a stable, permanent position    Task & responsibilities   Developing, reviewing and negotiating variations to contracts, programs, projects and services  Responding to inquiries and resolving problems concerning contracts, programs, projects, services provided, and persons affected  Managing paperwork associated with contracts, programs, projects and services provided  Working with project managers, builders, engineers and other stakeholders to ensure project goals are met  Advising senior management on matters requiring attention and assisting in implementing decisions  Overseeing work undertaken by contractors and reporting on variations to work orders  Preparing and reviewing submissions and reports concerning the organisation's activities  Collecting and analysing data associated with projects undertaken, and reporting on project outcomes    Qualification & experience   Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in contract administration, construction administration, or a similar role  Tertiary qualification in business, commerce, construction management, or a related discipline (or equivalent relevant experience)  Strong organisational and communication skills  Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)  Ability to liaise effectively with contractors, project stakeholders, and senior management  Sound understanding of contract documentation and compliance requirements   About Company     SBDC Testing is a trusted provider of concrete testing services, established in 2014 and operating across Australia. With a strong focus on accuracy, reliability, and integrity, SBDC has built a reputation for delivering high-quality testing solutions that support the successful delivery of major infrastructure and construction projects.    Our team works closely with builders, concrete suppliers, and engineers to ensure every aspect of testing is carried out in strict accordance with Australian Standards, providing confidence that all materials meet required specifications.    At SBDC Testing, we pride ourselves on being responsive, professional, and solutions focused. Our commitment is simple: accurate, timely and dependable testing that helps clients minimise risk, maintain compliance, and deliver projects with confidence. result.description: Efficient Recruitment Pty Ltd  The Architectural Draftsperson will prepare accurate architectural drawings and documentation for residential projects. You will work closely with building designers, engineers, consultants and internal construction staff to ensure projects are compliant, practical and delivered on schedule.   Benefits   Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.  Supportive and collaborative work environment.  Ongoing training and professional development.  Career growth opportunities within a growing residential building company.  Exposure to a wide range of residential projects.  On-site parking and convenient Modbury location.    Task & responsibilities   Prepare architectural drawings, plans, elevations, sections and details using AutoCAD and/or Revit.  Develop and update working drawings, specifications and documentation for planning and building approvals.  Ensure drawings comply with the National Construction Code (NCC), relevant Australian Standards and project requirements.  Coordinate with building designers, engineers, consultants and internal teams.  Amend drawings and documentation in response to client feedback, consultant input and project changes.  Maintain accurate project records, drawing registers and filing systems.  Assist with tender documentation, construction documentation and site-related drawing updates as required.  Support the design and construction teams with general documentation and administrative tasks.    Qualification & experience   Relevant qualification in Architectural Drafting, Building Design or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.  Demonstrated experience as an Architectural Draftsperson, preferably in residential building.  Proficiency in AutoCAD (2D and 3D); Revit knowledge is highly regarded.  Sound knowledge of Australian building codes, standards, construction methods and materials.  Strong technical drawing, documentation and problem-solving skills.  High attention to detail, accuracy and ability to interpret architectural drawings.  Strong communication and teamwork skills.  Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritise work and meet deadlines.   About Company     Stunning Homes Pty Ltd is a residential building company committed to delivering high-quality custom homes and renovations across South Australia. We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Architectural Draftsperson to join our team and support the design and delivery of residential building projects.
